description: This Java class, LogFragment, defines an Android Fragment that displays log messages in a scrollable, text-based view (LogView). It provides methods to create and initialize the UI components and manages text updates to ensure the latest log entries are visible.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that encapsulates a log display using a LogView inside a ScrollView.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView components, setting layout parameters, styles, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overrides Fragment's lifecycle method to inflate the view hierarchy and set up a TextWatcher for auto-scrolling on text changes.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within the fragment.
